name: Tavelo ARDEN
why_interesting: A light all-road race frameset with UDH, threaded BSA and unusually broad 34 mm dual-ring or 38 mm single-ring clearance.
missing: Current selected mainland checkout, stock and delivery terms
Exact mainland complete-build price, drivetrain and complete-bike weight

facts.frame: Tavelo Arden Race carbon frameset with UDH and 12×100 / 12×142 mm thru axles
facts.frame_material: Tavelo Toray Race Carbon; the current product page does not publish an exact fiber grade
facts.frame_construction: Fully internal aero all-road chassis with 410 mm chainstays and conventional replaceable UDH
facts.stiffness_evidence: Tavelo describes the Race lay-up as balancing stiffness and compliance; no independent measured exact-model stiffness result is published in the accepted evidence
facts.frame_weight_basis: Official size-L unpainted frame weight, 780±25 g; fork is 355 g and seatpost 115 g, both excluding paint and accessories
facts.tire_clearance_basis: Official maximum with a 1× drivetrain; the 2× maximum is 34 mm
facts.sizes: 425, 450, 475, 500, 525, 550, 570 and 590; official frame-weight basis is size L
facts.warranty: Lifetime first-owner frameset warranty; paint and decals one year, subject to policy conditions
facts.cockpit: Frameset listing includes fork and seatpost; cockpit configuration varies

observed_price.price_basis: Domestic launch report range for Arden Race and SL framesets without cockpit

official_price.price_basis: Current official global Arden Race pre-order price; excludes actual FX, shipping, tax and duties

price_status: domestic Race/SL launch range; current mainland selected checkout unverified
support_note: Official policy states lifetime frameset coverage for the original purchaser through official or authorized channels; serial and receipt are required, and paint/decals are covered for one year.
source_note: The current official Race specification supplies weights of 780±25 g frame, 355 g fork and 115 g seatpost in size L, excluding paint and accessories. The 38 mm maximum requires 1×; 2× is limited to 34 mm. The domestic launch report spans CNY 9,999 Race and CNY 12,999 SL framesets without cockpit, while the current global Race pre-order is USD 1,899. Current mainland stock and selected checkout remain unresolved.
